outcomes.outcome: commush.sh is installed in <localdir>/bin, root:root 0755, as the module ships it
in a clone, a confirmed run commits the tracked changes as the given name and email with the typed message and pushes them to origin's branch
declining the confirmation commits and pushes nothing; a missing email prints the usage and exits 1
a branch argument other than the current branch prints an error and the run goes on (the baseline's guard does not stop)
an https remote with a token prompt

uncovered.why: the https URL and the token prompt belong to git and the deployment's server, not to the script, whose commands are the same against any remote (the local origin here); the lab has no https git server
